title: Choose the visual world — bolder hand
question: Bolder re-roll: foreign forms at full commitment. The deal put City Lines in front. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again. Sketches now show the Accra city page on a desktop monitor (phone versions: same file names without -desktop in .impeccable/mocks/decision/). Values are sample data.

options.label: City Lines
options.lineage: Metro network diagrams fired in midnight-blue enamel
options.thesis: Rain, heat, air and river run as coloured lines through the city; status reads like a service board: good, watch, act.
options.viewport: Enamel status board 'Accra lines' with one coloured line per condition and its plain status; tonight's hours as stations along the rain line; map on tap.
options.risk: Dark enamel glares outdoors, so it stays on the status board and reading happens on porcelain; lines must stay schematic and never pose as geography.

raised.raise: Short type scale: two sizes, rank carried by weight, case and reversal.
Whole-cell grid: every block reflows in whole cells, never squeezed.
One time scrubber (now · tonight · tomorrow) restates every value on the page at once.

options.label: Live Tiles
options.thesis: Each condition a flat colour tile that flips when fresh data lands; the city name set huge and cropped.
options.viewport: Giant lowercase 'accra' cropped off the right edge over square tiles; the rain tile flooded with the accent.
options.case: Holds clarity — status at a glance; loses identification to City Lines.
options.risk: Colour fields shout on an ordinary day, and the black ground glares in sunlight.

options.label: Weather Cast
options.thesis: Every condition is a named character with a one-line note on what it means for you today.
options.viewport: A roster of characters — Big Rain, Harmattan Dust, Hot Afternoon — today's active one ribboned and enlarged with its note.
options.case: Holds identification for residents through plain-spoken characters; loses clarity for numbers and districts.
options.risk: Can read childish to decision-makers and trivialise flood risk; needs real illustrated characters.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.lineage: Pocket airline timetables on a light table
options.thesis: Raked glass slides, one type size for everything.
options.viewport: Topics as raked slides travelling sideways.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked containers cost readability on a phone, and nobody here knows the artifact.
options.kept: A short type scale; rank by weight and reversal.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Big values built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A grid-built '22 mm' filling the top half.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a Dutch design-world reference residents do not share; clarity no better than City Lines.

options.label: Axis Specimen
options.thesis: One slider morphs the whole page live.
options.viewport: A giant value with a slider beneath.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a type-nerd ritual with no link to rain or heat.
options.kept: One direct control restates the whole page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean weather and air-quality app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: City header, a grid of value tiles with icons, a map block below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any weather app by design.
